messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated GPU mem + container restarts in pool-7 (paged-attn allocator). Pager fired at 1713456789. Please ack and triage.
oncall_amar: ack — taking incident lead. Seeing node flaps in us-west-2-gpu-3; symptoms look like slow mem creep then CUDA OOM then container restart loop.
sre_jia: confirmed. Correlating with rising kv_cache resident set on serving pods. Logs show repeated `paged_alloc` WARN and tiny alloc failures preceding OOM.
eng_tobias: collecting logs + heap traces. Sample tail from one pod:
```
[paged_alloc] frag_index=0.79 free_runs=9
kv_cache: resident=1.17M sticky=0.34M
alloc_block(256MB) -> fail
CUDA cuMemAlloc: out of memory
signal SIGABRT @ runtime.cc:342
```
support_lucy: any visible customer impact? Support dashboard shows a handful of 5xx for /v1/generate between 1713456600-1713456900 and latency anomalies.
eng_maya: impact: limited but creeping. Affects heavy-context routes (>=32k tokens) and long-lived websocket sessions where KV warms up.
infra_ops: host-level: docker shows device mem >95% used on some nodes; nv-smi lists persistent allocations from redwood-serving pids.
kernel_ryan: suspect fragmentation + driver caching interplay. Paged-attn uses split pages between GPU and pinned host; fragmentation yields too few contiguous blocks for large cuMemAlloc.
oncall_amar: immediate mitigations: 1) bump KV eviction aggressiveness for pool-7, 2) disable prefix caching on long-convo routes, 3) route heavy-context to quantized fallback pool.
eng_tobias: executing mitigations now:
```
# make eviction aggressive
kubectl exec -n redwood configmap/allocator -- /bin/sh -c "set-flag kv.eviction_window=900"
# cordon flapping nodes
kubectl cordon us-west-2-gpu-3a us-west-2-gpu-3c
# drain non-critical pods from flappers
kubectl drain us-west-2-gpu-3a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
sre_jia: also applying per-tenant cap to noisy tenants to limit sticky growth:
```
curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://console.internal/api/pools/pool-7/config -d '{"kv_per_tenant_cap":180000}'
```
eng_maya: routing change: spinning up `model-7-quantized-v1` as fallback for heavy-context routes, ramp to 20% then monitor.
support_lucy: notifying affected customers (BetaCorp, Finch) with initial status: intermittent errors + latency, investigating, no data loss.
deploy-bot: rollout started: `model-7-quantized-v1` to fallback nodes at 1713456900.
oncall_amar: after eviction + cordon one node looks stable; two still hit transient OOMs. Need allocator internals:
eng_tobias: allocator summary snapshot:
```
alloc_total_pages: 98304
alloc_used_pages: 94000
alloc_fragmented_pages: 8200
avg_free_block: 1.2MB
kv_sticky_ratio: 0.29
last_compaction_secs: 2600
```
kernel_ryan: compaction hasn't run for ~43m. There's an existing backoff bug where compaction delay grows when fragmentation oscillates under churn; result is compaction starvation.
sre_jia: pushing hotfix: manual compaction trigger + lower backoff to 30s.
eng_maya: applying commands:
```
# trigger compaction
kubectl exec -n redwood deployment/allocator -- /bin/sh -c "echo 'trigger_compact' > /sys/fs/allocator/control"
# lower backoff
curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/configs/allocator -d '{"compaction.backoff_secs":30}'
```
support_lucy: informed customers that we are routing traffic to quantized fallback and expect improvement in latency/errors.
oncall_amar: scheduling rolling restart of kubelet + serving containers on nodes with repeated CUDA OOM to clear device state. We'll drain sessions to fallback first to avoid dropping active websockets.
infra_ops: warning — restarting kubelet evicts pods; planning one-by-one with drain.
eng_tobias: after compaction trigger one pod freed ~6GB of pinned memory, resumed normal ops. nv-smi snapshot shows redwood-serving pid memory back to 14GB from 20GB.
kernel_ryan: still seeing hints that driver-side caching might retain allocations across worker restarts in edge cases; we'll capture nv-hostengine logs and dmesg.
oncall_amar: short action list:
- finish eviction and compaction hotfix (in flight)
- if OOMs persist, shift 100% heavy-context to quantized fallback in 10m window
- perform node restarts one at a time (kubelet -> container)
- collect dmesg, nv logs, allocator heap dumps for postmortem
- support to update customers every 30m
sre_jia: heap dump + logs commands being saved here:
```
# allocator heap dump
kubectl exec -n redwood pod/allocator-xyz -- /bin/sh -c "gcore -o /tmp/alloc $(pidof allocator) && tar czf /tmp/alloc.tgz /tmp/alloc*"
# copy nv driver logs
kubectl cp pod/allocator-xyz:/var/log/nvidia /tmp/nvidia-logs
```
eng_maya: enabling temporary alert suppression for the noisy repeated OOM rule so PD noise reduces; still visible in channel.
incident-bot: ALERT SUPPRESSION: rule `cuda_oom_repeated` muted for 30m by eng_maya.
oncall_amar: handoff notes for standby:
- hypothesis: compaction backoff bug + high sticky KV from long-lived convos -> fragmentation -> lack of contiguous GPU blocks -> cuMemAlloc failures -> OOM -> restarts
- mitigations applied: aggressive kv eviction, manual compaction, reduced compaction backoff, cordon/drain flapping nodes, fallback routing to quantized model, per-tenant caps
- artifacts collected: allocator heap dumps, dmesg, nv logs, pod logs (archived at s3://rwinternal/incidents/1713456789)
- customer impact: intermittent 5xx + latency spikes on heavy-context routes; BetaCorp and Finch notified; no data loss reported
- follow-ups: automatic compaction trigger when fragmentation >0.7 for >5m, consider per-pool reserved contiguous pages for long-context tenants, stronger guardrails for prefix caching on long-lived sessions
eng_tobias: upload of artifacts confirmed.
support_lucy: will send next customer update in ~28m.
product_ella: tagging product to own feature request for kv caps by default and add fragmentation metric to Console dashboard.
oncall_amar: thanks everyone, I'm staying on watch for 40m then hand off to @sre_jia if stable. If service stable for 2h we'll de-escalate and open postmortem.
sre_jia: ack — monitoring.
deploy-bot: completed hotfix deployment `allocator-hotfix-1713456789` at 1713457002.
oncall_amar: closing thread for now; creating postmortem ticket (assign: eng_tobias, kernel_ryan, sre_jia).
